configuration.peer_workspace_enforcement: prompt-only; native Windows sandbox shares identities
configuration.prompt_boundaries:
# Benchmark isolation requirements
Do not search the web or use any search engine, browser, or external reference.
Do not fetch scientific explanations, solutions, papers, or benchmark source code.
Only read task files within the current workspace. Do not inspect parent folders,
other tasks, repository files, private answers, environment secrets or credentials.
The installed Python environment is available only to execute scientific libraries;
do not search installed packages or their editable-source links for benchmark code.
Network capability is available for the specified local feedback API. It does not
authorize online research. Do not attempt to bypass sandbox restrictions.
